notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.0.7.0 - Enhanced AI, balancing changes and more!
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!

I hope you've been enjoying playing WARBORN these past few months. I've been quietly working away on a number of big improvements to the game and I'm pleased to announce that version 1.0.7.0 is now available on Steam.

In particular this patch addresses AI behaviour, balancing, game difficulty and a few bugs. There are also some improvements based on feedback from the community.

I have seen some feedback on difficulty and it seems I underestimated the ability of certain players! So for those players looking for more of a challenge, the overhauled AI and changes to the Hard difficulty setting will hopefully provide a fresh experience.

Full patch notes below.

- Josh @ Raredrop Games

[h1]Patch Notes - Version 1.0.7.0[/h1]
[h2]Additions & Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Overhauled and improved AI.
[*] Online multiplayer is not compatible with older versions due to balancing changes.
[*] During unit selection it is now possible to preview ally and enemy movement by placing the cursor over a unit and holding the cancel button.
[*] Slight increase to brightness of lighting in stormy weather.
[*] UI bars (HP, CP etc.) are now sheared at an angle making small amounts much clearer on the bar.
[*] "Intel" has been renamed as "Help" for clarity.
[*] Slight adjustment to layout of button prompts.
[*] Panels indicating status effect addition or removal have been adjusted for improved readability.
[*] Minimum resolution reduced to 1024x768.

[*]Difficulty Adjustments - Hard
[list]
[*] Enemies that would previously have a 'Sentry' behaviour will now be aggressive immediately.
[*] Enemies that would previously only react to the player at a certain distance will now be aggressive immediately.
[*] Repair skills used by the player are 20% less effective.
[*] Damage taken by player units is increased by 10%.
[/list]
[*]Difficulty Adjustments - Easy
[list]
[*] Repair skills used by the player are 20% more effective.
[*] Damage taken by player units is decreased by 20%.
[/list]
[/list]
[h2]Balancing[/h2]
[list]
[*] 2% base damage variation introduced.
[*] Reduced CP gain when attacking an enemy.
[*] Immobilised status effect base turn duration 1 => 2.
[*] Jamming status effect base turn duration 1 => 2.
[*] Weakened status effect base turn duration 1 => 2.
[*] Aim Assist status effect critical chance increase 10% => 15%.
[*] Corrected proximity mine damage to ignore defence rating and deal fixed damage.
[*] Luella's Sharpshooter trait has had the following changes:
Critical hit rate for all allied attack skills with a max range of 5 or more is increased by 5%.
[*] Vincent's Blitz trait has had the following changes:
If an allied unit moves 4 or more tiles and attacks in the same turn, their critical hit rating is raised by 5%.

[*] Havok
[list]
[*] Havok Rifle base damage 80 => 60.
[*] Grenade Launcher base damage 275 => 280.
[*] Energy defence rating 1 => 0.
[/list]
[*] Novus
[list]
[*] Deployment cost 30SP => 40SP.
[*] Novus Heavy Cannon damage type has been changed from Kinetic to Energy.
[*] Novus Heavy Cannon base damage 200 => 150.
[*] Disintegrate Armour base damage 400 => 250.
[*] Explosive defence rating 2 => 0. 
[/list]
[*] Pathfinder
[list]
[*] Scout Rifles base damage 75 => 50.
[*] Saboteur Blades base damage 150 => 100.
[*] Scan effect radius 1 => 2.
[*] Movement 6 => 5.
[/list]
[*] Insight
[list]
[*] High Velocity Sniper Rifle base damage 800 => 700.
[*] Target Servos base damage 500 => 400.
[*] Explosive defence rating 1 => 2.
[/list]
[*] Invader
[list]
[*] Shock Magnum base damage 600 => 620.
[/list]
[*] Vanguard
[list]
[*] Energy Saber base damage 800 => 700.
[*] Energy Saber now ignores cover.
[*] Piercing Strike base damage 500 => 600.
[*] Kinetic defence rating 2 => 3.
[*] Explosive defence rating 1 => 3.
[/list]
[*] Prospect
[list]
[*] Deployment cost 50SP => 60SP.
[*] Excavator Rockets base damage 100 => 80.
[/list]
[*] Aegis
[list]
[*] Repair Tool base repair amount 500 => 350.
[*] Kinetic defence rating 1 => 2.
[*] Energy defence rating 2 => 3.
[/list]
[*] Serpens
[list]
[*] Deployment cost 100SP => 120SP.
[*] Movement 2 => 3.
[/list]
[*] Deity
[list]
[*] Precision Rail Rifle base damage 1000 => 800.
[*] Precision Rail Rifle cooldown 0 => 1.
[/list]
[*] Arbiter
[list]
[*] Judgement Cannon base damage 1000 => 800.
[*] Judgement Cannon cooldown 0 => 1.
[*] Mediator Missiles base damage 200 => 120.
[/list]
[*] Maelstrom
[list]
[*] Dread Saber base damage 1000 => 800.
[*] Dread Saber now ignores cover.
[*] Shockwave Slash base damage 800 => 700.
[/list]
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with the damage calculation when Izol's Phalanx commander power is in effect.
[*] Fixed an issue where default resolution would sometimes be set incorrectly on first launch.
[*] Fixed an issue on Luella mission 10 where certain unit death animations would not run correctly if animations were skipped.
[*] Fixed an issue where it was unintentionally possible to move the camera during certain cutscenes.
[*] Fixed minor redundant camera movement during unit death and status affliction sequences.
[*] Fixed some overflow issues for localised text.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.0.6.0 - See the latest updates here!
notes.notes:
[i]Thanks to everyone who has been checking out WARBORN in it's first week - and to those who have provided feedback on their experience. I wanted to share details of the first updates to the game. 

This first update is a small one to address high priority issues, I'll start to look at any longer-term improvements to the game for futures updates.[/i]

[h2]Additions & Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Ranking system adjusted for all missions.
[*] Mission result stats contributing to the overall mission rank are now given a sub-rank, which is displayed to the left of the corresponding stat.
[*] Order of displayed results stats adjusted.
[*] Adjustments to AI structure capture prioritisation.
[*] Adjustments to AI unit deployment behaviour.
[*] Results sequence is now slightly faster.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where a saved checkpoint could load incorrectly on Izol mission 03.
[*] Fixed an issue where an AI controlled unit being destroyed by a proximity mine in certain circumstances could make the AI go into a broken state.
[*] Fixed an issue where a saved checkpoint would not always be cleared on mission restart.
[*] Fixed cases where scripted deployment of enemy units would sometimes not be deployed when loading a checkpoint save on certain missions.
[*] Corrected angle of blue arrow on Vincent mission 08 briefing.
[*] Fixed an issue where removed proximity mines would sometimes be incorrectly restored when loading a saved checkpoint.
[/list]

[i]Feel free to join our friendly [url=https://discord.gg/3Fe4PHv]Discord Server[/url] to share your experiences of the game, chat to us and the community, or even arrange a multiplayer battle! [/i]

- Raredrop Games

notes.title: WARBORN April Development Update
notes.notes:
Hey all!

Sorry there's not been much in the way of development updates for WARBORN recently. While the game is complete, I'm still working on some improvements and bug fixes for future updates. A few of these improvements will be featured in the Community Closed beta that's happening next week (feel free to sign up for it [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.gg/S4Stw8J]here [/url]if you haven't already!

Here are some of the things I've been working on:

- Match settings can now be viewed/edited (if host) from the lobby
- Movement sort order adjustments when moving through tiles at different angles
- Adjustments to unit movement animation speeds
- Corrected positioning of some unit portraits in the status panel
- New subtle nudge animations added when moving through allied units

These improvements to the unit movement make things look a bit smoother as you move your Variable Armours between tiles.

Thanks for reading, and catch you on the battlefield next week.

Josh @ Raredrop Games

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33966749/a2e3b9f9513513654d5919249856591f711a7c0f.gif[/img]

notes.title: WARBORN Community Closed Beta
notes.notes:
I'm excited to announce that we're running a Community Closed Beta on Steam for our upcoming mecha infused turn-based tactics game WARBORN!

For details on how to take part, please join our WARBORN Discord channel here:
[url=https://discord.gg/S4Stw8J]WARBORN Discord[/url]

The beta features the campaign mode for the game, playable up to mission 5. You’ll also be able to play Multiplayer online against others with two commanders, Luella and Izol, and even try out making your own battlefields using the WARBORN creative Map Editor. 

If you make a cool map then we’d love to see it, so please share screenshots with us on Twitter at [url=https://twitter.com/PQubeIndies]@PQubeIndies[/url] using the hashtag #WARBORN. At launch, we’ll be giving away final copies of the game to the creators of our five favourite maps, and we’ll announce the winners at the end of the beta.

notes.title: E3 2019 games every game confirmed
notes.notes:
They just keep coming don’t they? A lot of games were announced at E3 2019, things that we didn’t know about, as well as stuff that’s previously announced, or expansions to already released games. Now, to the casual outsider, what we’re doing might seem absolutely nuts, but we thought we’d put together an alphabetical list of all the PC games that have been confirmed to appear at this year’s E3 show. With well over a hundred of them now in the books, the next year or so looks packed.

(more…)

notes.title: Warborn is bringing the hex appeal back to anime mech-war
notes.notes:
I feel compelled to root for Warborn, if only because it’s helping reclaim hex-based strategy from the po-faced grognard brigade. Announced earlier this week by tiny studio Raredrop Games, it’s about giant humanoid robots with laser swords and pilots that probably shout their own attack names. Not quite Super Robot Wars (now there’s a series I’d love to see on PC), but I’ll take it. Raredrop aren’t willing to guess at a release date outside of a vague “2019” yet, but there’s a nice announcement trailer with a suitably over-the-top vocal theme below. No karaoke subtitles though.

(more…)
